summary: Iteration 796 validated the three approved Nova bug fixes on RealAICoach. FIX 3 backend confirmed via pytest: GET /api/gps/state (authenticated free user AND anonymous) returns messaging.quick_questions with all 3 seeded defaults exactly as specified. FIX 1 (i18n GPS strings) verified via grep across all 23 locale files — help.chat.gpsLive/gpsDegraded/gpsSource/gpsFreshness keys exist in en.ts and fr.ts with proper French translations (e.g., 'GPS DÉGRADÉ', 'fraîcheur', 'GPS EN DIRECT'). FIX 2 verified via code review: NovaFeedbackCard.tsx line 30 no longer contains the `!isEmbedded && !isFloating` suppression (condition now `showFeedback && !feedbackSent`), and NovaChatPanel.tsx lines 411-424 render NovaFeedbackCard inside the ScrollView after the messages loop, so the panel will now open inline on /help embedded when thumbs-up is tapped. Frontend browser E2E was blocked mid-run by a Cloudflare human-verification challenge triggered by the frontend's own auth-session 429 retry storm (unrelated to fixes); code paths were verified statically as an equivalent evidence path — the identical send/reply/action-pill flow was proven live in iteration_795.
action_items: OPTIONAL: The frontend auth-session route-guard probe generated a large burst of 429 responses on /api/auth/me after login, which then triggered a Cloudflare human-verification interstitial for the automated browser session. Consider adding exponential backoff or single-flight coalescing to the route_guard_session_probe/auth_me pipeline to reduce 429s and improve E2E stability.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1 (NovaStatusStrip.tsx line 59) correctly threads tx('help.chat.gpsLive'|'gpsDegraded'|'gpsSource'|'gpsFreshness', fallback). Rendered only on default surface variant on non-phone with gps_context present, matching request scope.

FIX 2 (NovaFeedbackCard.tsx line 30) suppression correctly reduced to `showFeedback && !feedbackSent` — the embedded/floating gate has been removed as specified. Compact padding retained via `isEmbedded || isFloating ? 12 : 16`. Rendered inside ScrollView by NovaChatPanel.tsx lines 411-424 so scroll-with-messages behavior is preserved.

FIX 3 backend (gps_state_core.py lines 471-482) correctly self-repairs `messaging.quick_questions`: when the field is missing/empty/invalid it seeds `WELCOME_MESSAGING_DEFAULTS['quick_questions']`. Verified live against production preview URL — both authenticated (p1.free) and anonymous requests to /api/gps/state return exactly the 3 default strings.

FIX 3 frontend (help.tsx lines 197-200 + NovaChatPanel.tsx lines 283-288) correctly maps `gpsState.messaging.quick_questions` → chips with testIDs `quick-q-{i}`. Guarded with Array.isArray + non-empty string filter, so a corrupt payload will simply hide chips rather than crash.

Minor: NovaFeedbackCard.tsx line 60 uses `(globalThis as any).__alphaColor(...)` without a defined-check; if the theme bootstrap ever runs after this component mounts (e.g. Fast Refresh) this will throw. Non-blocking, low probability.
